description: Price from WooCommerce and this product description. Owner policy: quantity gaps and overlapping boundaries use the next/higher volume tier (lower price). Other ambiguity gives requires_confirmation with no quote. Always state net/gross, unit, billable quantity, source and exclusions. Full availability is declared by the store owner, without inventory verification. Checkout discount is not verified.
